queries.result: First-party Hindi discovery identified Rajasthan Apna Khata/BhuNaksha and official Bandikui municipal/urban-government records. The indexed material confirms Bandikui as a municipal area and provides planning/ward evidence, but no anonymous parcel vector response was exposed.

registryEvidence: Rajasthan Government Revenue Board's Apna Khata/BhuNaksha services are official cadastral and land-record custodians, while Rajdharaa Urban GIS attributes khasra and village boundaries to the Settlement Department and directs final authentication to the concerned local body/town-planning records. Bandikui-specific Rajasthan urban-government planning and municipal boundary/ward documents were found. This verifies a local/state cadastral-map and municipal map custodian, not an open parcel API or citywide parcel coverage.
